```python
def solution(items):
    """Returns the median of the list."""
    if not items:
        return 0
    sorted_items = sorted(items)
    n = len(sorted_items)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return sorted_items[mid]
    return (sorted_items[mid - 1] + sorted_items[mid]) // 2
```
